title: A generic stack
description:
Write a stack that works for any type.

```
pushed 1, 2, 3
peek: Some(3)
pop: Some(3), Some(2), Some(1), None
largest of [3, 9, 4]: Some(9)
```
hints: `largest` starts with `let mut best = *items.first()?;` and loops over the rest.
requirements: `struct Stack<T> { items: Vec<T> }` with `new`, `push`, `pop`, `peek(&self) -> Option<&T>`, `len` and `is_empty`.
A generic function `fn largest<T: PartialOrd + Copy>(items: &[T]) -> Option<T>`.
stretch: Implement `Default` for `Stack<T>` and add `fn drain_all(&mut self) -> Vec<T>`.
